settings.showExtInNameDescription: Shows the file extension in the item name label.
settings.showExtAsTagDescription: Shows the file extension as a tag at the end of the item entry.
settings.showFoldArrowsDescription: Shows the folder folding arrows on the right side.
settings.customFileIconsDescription: Allow displaying custom icons configured in the file.
settings.customFolderIconsDescription: Allow displaying custom icons configured in the folder.
